caption: The drawing depicts two glass objects placed side by side against a light beige background. On the left is a circular or dome-shaped paperweight shown from a top-down view, containing a blue ribbon-like band with white text that reads "Anna M. Brown / Bridgeton, N.J." The band is bordered above and below by twisted red and white ropes, while pink and yellow swirling decorations are visible at the top and bottom. The right object presents the same paperweight, but from a side perspective, revealing its domed shape, transparency, and the distortion of the internal decorations due to its curvature. The paperweight is rendered in delicate shades of gray, blue, pink, red, yellow, and white. The composition is otherwise minimalistic, with no other objects or background details present. A small artist’s signature, “F.T.Munghall,” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Paper Weight
